about: Q-codes in everyday amateur use. With ? they ask; without, they answer or state.
items: Is this frequency in use? / This frequency is busy
Have you anything for me? / I have nothing for you
Are you ready? / I am ready
Full break-in: I can hear you between my signals
Can you acknowledge? / I acknowledge receipt (also: a confirmation card)
What is your location? / My location is
I am listening on another frequency
